title: The ESXi host Secure Shell (SSH) daemon must not permit user environment settings.
check_content:
From an ESXi shell, run the following command:

# /usr/lib/vmware/openssh/bin/sshd -T|grep permituserenvironment

Expected result:

permituserenvironment no

If the output does not match the expected result, this is a finding.
fixtext:
From an ESXi shell, add or correct the following line in "/etc/ssh/sshd_config":

PermitUserEnvironment no
VulnDiscussion: SSH environment options potentially allow users to bypass access restriction in some configurations. Users must not be able to present environment options to the SSH daemon.
